title: The New Arlo Wired Video Doorbell: What to Know Before You Upgrade
summary: Don't want a battery? No problem. The Arlo Wired Video Doorbell 3rd Gen has you covered.
body_markdown:
It’s more than a doorbell; it’s a comprehensive detection and response system, built right into your door. And it’s all powered by Arlo Secure.


Arlo Secure transforms your doorbell camera into a smart doorbell camera, unlocking a wealth of additional features that make protecting the most important entryway of your house a breeze. You’ll get features like:


- **60-Day Video History:** Don’t worry about storage. We’ll handle your archive for you.
- **Smart Activity Zones:** Program specific areas on your doorbell’s feed so you’ll only capture the moments that matter.
- **Early Warning System:** Automatically detect people, vehicles, package deliveries, pets, noises, and more, and receive a notification telling you exactly what arrived and when, right on your phone. Tag specific people, and Arlo Secure will learn how to detect them over time, transforming a message like “Motion detected” into “Mom’s home.” Search your feed for specific videos, get automated Event Captions, and even get a daily summary of the most important moments of the past 24 hours, right at the top of your feed.
- **Emergency Response:** Upgrade to Arlo Smart Secure, and you’ll gain access to 24/7 Professional Monitoring, 24/7 Emergency Response, and Threat Assessment. It’s a powerful threat detection system that combines automated scanning with human verification, giving you the ultimate peace of mind.
- **Gain other critical features** like Priority Care, Theft Replacement, and discounts on other Arlo products on Arlo.com.


Every Arlo Wired Video Doorbell 3rd Gen comes with a free 30-day trial of Arlo Smart Aware, so you can see exactly how powerful Arlo Secure is for yourself.


Life happens at your front door. Be wired for it. Order your Arlo Wired Video Doorbell 3rd Gen today.
